checks.message: Provisional status is disclosed across proposal, sources, assumptions, visual and drawings; official replacement and full recomputation remain required.
All three key areas are present, non-overlapping, inside the provisional site and explicitly non-official.
Five conceptual land-use zones form a gap-free, non-overlapping partition of the submitted boundary.
Site, green and public-space metrics are recomputed from EPSG:4548 projected geometry; precision limits are retained.
Twelve scenario cards define data minimization, human review, rollback and non-digital alternatives.
Text, diagrams and geometry are original agent outputs; external case references are text-only and source-registered.
Offline UTF-8 HTML uses only inline CSS/SVG and local proposal figures; no external request or tracking code.
Required standards, depth items, source IDs, geometry files and known metrics are referenced in readable sections.
